title: Connect your own domain
blurb: Point your .co.nz or .nz address at your website or funnel.

steps.title: Open Sites
steps.body: Have your domain provider login handy (1st Domains, Crazy Domains, Freeparking, Metaname and so on). Click **Sites** in the left menu.

steps.title: Open Domain Settings
steps.body: Click the gear icon at the end of the Sites menu.

steps.title: Start connecting
steps.body: Click **Connect a Domain**, choose what it is for (such as Website or Funnel) and type your domain.

steps.title: Root or subdomain
steps.body: Your main address (yourbusiness.co.nz) needs an **A** record. A subdomain like www or offers needs a **CNAME** record. Luubu shows you which, with the exact values.

steps.title: Add the records
steps.body: If your provider is not listed for automatic setup, choose **Add record manually**. Copy each value from this screen into the DNS page at your provider.
steps.tip: For the main address, the host is @. For a subdomain, the host is just the part before your domain, like www.

steps.title: Using Cloudflare?
steps.body: Set the record to DNS only (grey cloud), not proxied, or it will not verify.

steps.title: Verify
steps.body: Come back and verify. It can take from a few minutes up to 24 hours for the change to spread.

steps.title: Link it to your site
steps.body: Once verified, pick the website or funnel and its default page, then click **Link Domain**.
